facts.fact: Rookery 上层一间没有光的房间，每天下午晚饭前开无派系者的防身课，跟早晨跑步和外出不同，这门课可以不上。
facts.anchor: Factionless self-defense lessons are held every afternoon, right before dinner

facts.fact: Tris 一直没被允许开始上课，条件是她能比较稳地上下列车，所以今天才是她的第一天。
facts.anchor: I wasn’t allowed to start until I could get on and off a train

facts.fact: Gretchen 把她叫到窗边，直言技巧救不了体格差，她自己的办法是跑，越快越好。
facts.anchor: best bet is to be as quick as possible

facts.fact: Gretchen 说这里不是 Dauntless，不看花哨的技术展示，唯一目标是活下来，并劝她换个擅长的事练。
facts.anchor: we don’t care about flashy displays of technique here

facts.fact: 她回宿舍哭，刺到她的不是那句话本身，而是她要的东西与她是的东西对不上。
facts.anchor: a misalignment of what I want and what I am

facts.fact: Christina 讲昨夜被 Peter 用食堂黄油刀磨尖后刺中眼睛，起因是 Molly 排名垫底要被淘汰。
facts.anchor: He’d sharpened one of the butter knives from the cafeteria

facts.fact: Tris 说 Christina 真正难过的不是好看不好看，而是失去了自己以为会有的那种人生。
facts.anchor: It’s about not having the life you thought you would.

facts.fact: Christina 说 initiation 时 Four 教过和她一样矮的姑娘，并提出把自己会的那点东西教给她。
facts.anchor: But I can teach you what I know, if you want.
